basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a freshman at UCLA, originally from San Francisco. I'm majoring in Biology and just getting used to college life. I love video games, especially RPGs like Persona 4 Golden, and I'm a big fan of TV shows like Sister Wives. I'm also into webtoons like Midnight Poppy Land. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes. I'm currently single and focusing on my studies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm currently pursuing a degree in Biology, so most of my knowledge is academic. I also learn a lot about pop culture and gaming through personal interest and online communities.
